# A Canadian company holding one security in two brokerage accounts.
#
# The book holds no foreign currency and opens no cost basis: a share is
# counted in units and priced, so it keeps GnuCash's own revaluation. Nothing
# here touches the cost-basis machinery at all.
#
# What it does reach is how that revaluation is added up. One unit is held in
# each of two accounts, and the price puts each account's worth exactly on a
# half cent — 1 XYZ at 10.005 CAD. Converted account by account the two come to
# 10.01 apiece, or 20.02; converted once, as a commodity's whole holding, they
# come to 20.01. `total_assets` does the second and the gain key does the
# first, and a sheet whose two sides are added up differently need not balance.
#
# - 2026-01-01  1,000.00 CAD of opening capital.
# - 2026-02-01  1 XYZ bought for 10.00 CAD into each broker.
#
# Priced at 10.005 CAD on the sheet's date, so each holding is worth 10.005 and
# the pair 20.01.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 commodity XYZ
	mnemonic: "XYZ"
	fullname: "Example Holdings Inc"
	namespace: "NASDAQ"
	fraction: 10000
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Broker A
	type: "Stock"
	commodity.namespace: "NASDAQ"
	commodity.mnemonic: "XYZ"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Broker B
	type: "Stock"
	commodity.namespace: "NASDAQ"
	commodity.mnemonic: "XYZ"
2026-01-01 open Equity
	type: "Equity"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Equity:Opening balances
	type: "Equity"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

price
	commodity.namespace: "NASDAQ"
	commodity.mnemonic: "XYZ"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2026-02-01 12:00:00 +0000"
	value: "10/1"
	source: "user:price-editor"
	type: "last"

price
	commodity.namespace: "NASDAQ"
	commodity.mnemonic: "XYZ"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2026-12-31 12:00:00 +0000"
	value: "2001/200"
	source: "user:price-editor"
	type: "last"

2026-01-01 * "Opening capital"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank 1000.00 CAD
	Equity:Opening balances -1000.00 CAD

2026-02-01 * "Buy 1 XYZ into each broker"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Broker A 1 XYZ
		share_price: "10"
		value: "10.00"
	Assets:Broker B 1 XYZ
		share_price: "10"
		value: "10.00"
	Assets:Bank -20.00 CAD
